rows.capability: Checkpoint refuses to stage another open session's work when a second unfinished session shares the tree
rows.library: packages/cli/src/checkpoint.mjs — otherOpenChangeDirs + the pending classifier + the refusal gate
rows.runtimeOwner: packages/cli/src/checkpoint.mjs — the `forge checkpoint` CLI command (invoked by the coordinator at a task-group boundary)
rows.writes: a git commit staging only the session's own work, or a non-zero refusal with no commit; the checkpoint sha recorded on this session's session.json
rows.reads: the working tree (pendingEntries), .forge/sessions/*/session.json for other open sessions, the project plan dir
rows.uiConsumer: the coordinator reading the refusal/commit result; the group reviewer receiving groupRange

rows.capability: --path scopes a checkpoint to an explicit subset plus the session's own change dir
rows.writes: a git commit containing only the named paths and the session's change dir; a refusal when a named path is under another open session's change dir
rows.reads: the --path values, the working tree, other open sessions' change dirs
rows.uiConsumer: the coordinator committing its own group while a second session is open
